name: decidio-approvals
description: A person approves Claude Code's destructive shell commands before they run - rm -rf, git push --force, DROP TABLE, terraform apply, kubectl delete, npm publish, curl | sh. Each approval is a sealed, verifiable Authority Receipt for that exact command. Also sets up Decidio deploy approvals in a GitHub repository: a person approves each deploy before it runs. Installs the decidio plugin (the connector and its skill) with it.
